title: Essential Duality and Quantitative Channel Composability in Algebraic Quantum Field Theory
summary: Let \(O\mapsto A(O)\) be a local Haag--Kastler net and let \(A^d(O)=A(O')'\) be its dual net. Normal unital completely positive maps on \(B(H)\) that fix \(A(O')\) pointwise are exactly the channels with Kraus operators in \(A^d(O)\). Thus Haag duality at \(O\) is equivalent to equality with the \(A(O)\)-inner channels, while essential duality is equivalent to order-independence of the corresponding causal-complement channel classes at spacelike separation.
